section.group: Threat Hunting With The Elastic Stack

questions.question: Navigate to http://[Target IP]:5601 and follow along as we hunt for Stuxbot. In the part where default.exe is under investigation, a VBS file is mentioned. Enter its full name as your answer, including the extension.
Stuxbot uploaded and executed mimikatz. Provide the process arguments (what is after .\mimikatz.exe, ...) as your answer.

Some PowerShell code has been loaded into memory that scans/targets network shares. Leverage the available PowerShell logs to identify from which popular hacking tool this code derives. Answer format (one word): P____V___
questions.hint: Take various pieces of code from the scriptblock and submit it to search engines.
